description: PAID: $0.50 USDC per call on Base (x402), charged only for valid input. Deterministic liquidity forecast. Projects daily cash balance from opening cash and a list of scheduled cash flow events over a forecast horizon, flags minimum-buffer breaches, and classifies liquidity status. Optionally also computes standard working-capital ratios (DSO/DPO/DIO/cash conversion cycle) from a supplied balance snapshot. Requires USDC payment via the x402 protocol (Circle Gateway) — see the 402 response for the payment flow. All figures are computed deterministically (no LLM). Call get_example_input first if unsure of the shape.

cashFlows.description: Each date must be on or after startDate; dates beyond the horizon are excluded from the projection (and flagged in warnings/data_quality) rather than rejected.

amount.description: Signed amount; positive is an inflow, negative is an outflow.

workingCapital.description: Optional standard accounting ratios (DSO/DPO/DIO/cash conversion cycle) computed from a balance snapshot and period flow — independent of the cashFlows-based daily projection above.

inventory.description: Optional inventory balance snapshot — enables days_inventory_outstanding and a full cash conversion cycle.

periodCOGS.description: Cost of goods sold / purchases over the reference period, in baseCurrency.

periodCreditSales.description: Credit sales over the reference period, in baseCurrency.

periodDays.description: Length of the reference period in days (e.g. 365 for a trailing year, 90 for a quarter).

name: liquidity_forecast
